title: Civica purpose record (spec 0.1)
description: The declared purpose GETTING_STARTED.md step 1 requires. Refusal and rest records reference it by purpose_id; without it they are undefined. An update to purpose is a new record that supersedes the old one, which stays in the set (Article V, PROTOCOLS/MEMORY.md).

time.description: When this purpose was declared. Refusal and rest records that reference it must not predate it.

system_id.description: Stable identifier of the system this purpose is declared for.

purpose_id.description: Identifier other records use to reference this declaration. Unique within the system's record set.

purpose.description: What this system is for, in one or two sentences.

known_harms.description: Harm already known in this domain. A domain with no known harm has not been looked at.

never.description: What this system must never do.

scope_out.description: What the system cannot do and will refuse.

human_oversight.description: How humans intervene, override, appeal, and revise (Article VI).

supersedes.description: purpose_id of the declaration this one replaces, or null for a first declaration. The superseded record must remain in the set.
